title: Posting Late Fees on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
## When a late fee is posted

Under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement, a late fee is posted once for a billing period whose rent is still unpaid at the end of its grace period, against the unpaid rent charge of that period. The fee is due whenever the ledger shows such a period without its late fee.

A late fee for an unpaid period is not posted until each earlier late fee that was charged against a period paid within its grace period carries a billing-error correction credit on the ledger.

Restated as a condition on the ledger: so long as any earlier late fee charged against a period that was paid within its grace period stands without a billing-error correction credit on the ledger, no late fee for an unpaid period is posted; once every such fee carries that credit, the late fee for the unpaid period may be posted.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Which period | A billing period whose rent is still unpaid at the end of its grace period |
| How many fees | One per such period |
| Tied to | The unpaid rent charge of that period, and that period's due date |
| Ledger condition | Each earlier late fee charged against a period paid within its grace period carries a billing-error correction credit on the ledger |

## Booking the fee: `post_parking_late_fee_42918014`

**Capability.** Posts a late fee on a parking agreement's ledger for one billing period whose rent is unpaid: one fee entry of the kind "late fee", dated today, tied to the unpaid rent charge it arises from and to that billing period's due date, is added to the agreement's ledger, and the agreement's balance due rises by the fee. The tenant sees the fee on the ledger and the higher balance at once.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `post_parking_late_fee_42918014` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `parking_rental_id` — the parking agreement number of the agreement being charged, as returned by the parking agreement lookup for this tenant (identifier).
- `reference_entry_id` — the ledger entry number of the unpaid rent charge the late fee arises from, as returned by the parking ledger lookup for the agreement (identifier).
- `period_start` — the due date of the billing period the late fee relates to, in YYYY-MM-DD format, exactly as shown on that rent charge.
- `amount` — the late fee in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as given.

**Return.** The call is complete when the receipt comes back with `fee_entry_id` (the new ledger entry number), `parking_rental_id`, `reference_entry_id` (the rent charge the fee arises from), `fee_type` (always `late_fee`), `period_start` (YYYY-MM-DD due date of the period), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places as booked), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD posting date) and `balance_due` (USD with 2 decimal places, the agreement's resulting balance due).
